observations: Photo 0: A used automotive transmission/gearbox assembly lying on dirt ground, with attached wiring harness and sensor connectors, visibly dirty and oxidized. Another gearbox wrapped in a tarp beside it, and partial engine/other parts in background. A blue plastic crate at bottom left.

Photo 1: Closer view of the same transmission unit, showing bell housing, wiring harness, a black cylindrical component (possibly a solenoid or sensor housing), and a yellow paint dot marking on the housing. Ground is sandy/dirt with scattered plastic debris.

Photo 2: Another angle of the same transmission, showing the bell housing with a number marking (partially visible, looks like '39' painted or stamped), wiring harness, and the same black cylindrical part. Blue crate and teal cloth visible in foreground.
not_shown: Vehicle make/model and compatibility of the transmission
Internal condition of gears, clutch plates, and seals
Mileage or usage history of the transmission
Whether it is manual or automatic and number of speeds
Presence of fluid leaks or damage not visible externally
Completeness of all mounting bolts, sensors, and electrical connectors
